it: Chi dorme non piglia pesci
say: kee DOR-meh nohn PEE-lyah PEH-shee
lit: Whoever sleeps doesn't catch fish.
en: The early bird catches the worm.

it: Meglio tardi che mai
say: MEH-lyoh TAR-dee keh MY
lit: Better late than never.
en: Better late than never.

it: Chi va piano va sano e va lontano
say: kee vah PYAH-noh vah SAH-noh eh vah lohn-TAH-noh
lit: Whoever goes slowly goes safely and goes far.
en: Slow and steady wins the race.

it: L'abito non fa il monaco
say: LAH-bee-toh nohn fah eel MOH-nah-koh
lit: The habit doesn't make the monk.
en: Don't judge a book by its cover.

it: Tra il dire e il fare c'è di mezzo il mare
say: trah eel DEE-reh eh eel FAH-reh cheh dee MED-dzoh eel MAH-reh
lit: Between saying and doing lies the sea.
en: Easier said than done.

it: Chi trova un amico trova un tesoro
say: kee TROH-vah oon ah-MEE-koh TROH-vah oon teh-ZOH-roh
lit: Whoever finds a friend finds a treasure.
en: A good friend is a treasure.

it: Non tutte le ciambelle riescono col buco
say: nohn TOOT-teh leh chahm-BEL-leh RYES-koh-noh kohl BOO-koh
lit: Not all donuts come out with a hole.
en: Things don't always turn out as planned.

it: Quando il gatto non c'è, i topi ballano
say: KWAHN-doh eel GAHT-toh nohn CHEH, ee TOH-pee BAHL-lah-noh
lit: When the cat's not there, the mice dance.
en: When the cat's away, the mice will play.

it: Paese che vai, usanza che trovi
say: pah-EH-zeh keh VYE, oo-ZAHN-tsah keh TROH-vee
lit: Country you go to, custom you find.
en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

it: Volere è potere
say: voh-LEH-reh eh poh-TEH-reh
lit: To want is to be able.
en: Where there's a will, there's a way.

it: Il tempo è denaro
say: eel TEM-poh eh deh-NAH-roh
lit: Time is money.
en: Time is money.

it: Chi la fa l'aspetti
say: kee lah FAH lahs-PET-tee
lit: Whoever does it should expect it.
en: What goes around comes around.

it: Ride bene chi ride ultimo
say: REE-deh BEH-neh kee REE-deh OOL-tee-moh
lit: He laughs well who laughs last.
en: He who laughs last laughs best.

it: Lontano dagli occhi, lontano dal cuore
say: lohn-TAH-noh DAH-lyee OHK-kee, lohn-TAH-noh dahl KWOH-reh
lit: Far from the eyes, far from the heart.
en: Out of sight, out of mind.

it: Meglio un uovo oggi che una gallina domani
say: MEH-lyoh oon WOH-voh OHD-jee keh OO-nah gahl-LEE-nah doh-MAH-nee
lit: Better an egg today than a hen tomorrow.
en: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.

it: Can che abbaia non morde
say: kahn keh ahb-BYE-ah nohn MOR-deh
lit: A dog that barks doesn't bite.
en: His bark is worse than his bite.

it: Roma non fu fatta in un giorno
say: ROH-mah nohn foo FAHT-tah een oon JOR-noh
lit: Rome wasn't made in a day.
en: Rome wasn't built in a day.

it: Chi cerca trova
say: kee CHER-kah TROH-vah
lit: Whoever searches finds.
en: Seek and you shall find.

it: Dimmi con chi vai e ti dirò chi sei
say: DEEM-mee kohn kee VYE eh tee dee-ROH kee SAY
lit: Tell me who you go with and I'll tell you who you are.
en: You are the company you keep.

it: Batti il ferro finché è caldo
say: BAHT-tee eel FER-roh feen-KEH eh KAHL-doh
lit: Strike the iron while it's hot.
en: Strike while the iron is hot.

it: Non è tutto oro quello che luccica
say: nohn eh TOOT-toh OH-roh KWEL-loh keh LOOCH-chee-kah
lit: Not all that glitters is gold.
en: All that glitters is not gold.

it: A caval donato non si guarda in bocca
say: ah kah-VAHL doh-NAH-toh nohn see GWAR-dah een BOHK-kah
lit: You don't look in a gifted horse's mouth.
en: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.
